stories.title: Maharashtra clocks highest car sales in Q2 FY27, Uttar Pradesh leads two-wheeler chart - HT Auto
Maharashtra tops passenger and commercial vehicle sales, UP leads two- and three-wheelers in Q2: SIAM - ET Auto
India electric vehicle retail sales reach record high
stories.summary: India recorded 333,634 electric vehicle retail sales in September, a 74 percent increase year-on-year according to the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations. EV penetration rose to 13 percent, up from 10 percent during the same month last year. Demand was strongest in the two-wheeler and passenger vehicle segments.

stories.title: Auto stocks rally on lower commodity costs
stories.summary: The Nifty Auto index climbed over 4 percent on Thursday as falling crude oil prices fueled investor optimism regarding input costs. Maruti Suzuki led the gains with a 5 percent increase. The sector outperformed the broader Nifty 50 index, which rose 0.53 percent during the same period.

stories.title: Auto sector leads market gains
stories.summary: The Nifty Auto index rose 2.6 percent to 28,111.95 on Thursday morning, outpacing the Nifty 50 index. Investors are betting on improved operational performance for manufacturers as commodity prices decline. The index remains the top gainer among sectoral indices on the National Stock Exchange.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki shares jump 5%, M&M, Tata Motors, Eicher Motors rally as Nifty Auto surges 2.6% - Moneycontrol.com
Auto stocks rise as demand outlook improves
stories.summary: The Nifty Auto index rose 3 percent on November 19, 2026, supported by a positive demand outlook and better operating margins. Maruti Suzuki shares increased 6.48 percent to 13,451 rupees. Mahindra and Mahindra and Hyundai Motor India also recorded gains exceeding 4 percent during the session.

stories.title: Auto stocks continue upward trend
stories.summary: Automobile stocks traded higher on November 19, 2026, with Maruti Suzuki shares rising 5.35 percent to 13,308 rupees. Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles and Mahindra and Mahindra also posted gains above 3 percent. The Nifty 50 index advanced 0.27 percent during the same morning trading session.

stories.title: Will cars finally get cheaper in India? German envoy breaks down the price impact of the India-EU FTA | WION India-EU FT
Maruti Brezza leads sub-4-metre SUV sales
stories.summary: The Maruti Brezza was the best-selling sub-compact SUV in October 2026 with 22,436 units sold. This represents an increase of 10,364 units compared to October 2025. While the Brezza gained the top spot, other models including the Kia Sonet and Mahindra Bolero saw significant sales declines.

stories.title: Hyundai’s New 7-Seater SUV Spied to XUV 7XO Rival With Hybrid Power? - India Car News
Hyundai tests new hybrid SUV
stories.summary: Hyundai is testing a camouflaged SUV, codenamed NI1i, in South Korea. The vehicle is expected to sit above the Alcazar in the company's Indian product range. It is intended to compete with the Mahindra XUV 7XO, Tata Safari, and Mahindra Scorpio N when it arrives in showrooms.

stories.title: JSW Combat SUV set for December debut
stories.summary: JSW Motors will debut its first model, the plug-in hybrid Combat, on December 3. The SUV is based on the international Jetour T2, with the India-spec version replacing the original branding on the front grille. The company plans to introduce the vehicle through local assembly.

stories.title: Hyundai reveals Neira electric MPV
stories.summary: Hyundai has unveiled the production-ready Neira electric MPV in Indonesia. The seven-seater vehicle shares design and underpinnings with the Kia Carens Clavis EV already sold in India. The Neira will be showcased at the Gaikindo Jakarta Auto Week 2026 beginning November 20.

stories.title: Hyundai hybrid SUV spotted in Korea
stories.summary: A camouflaged Hyundai hybrid SUV, reportedly the NI1i, has been spotted testing in Korea. The vehicle is expected to be positioned between the Alcazar and Palisade in the Indian market. It is intended to compete against the Toyota Fortuner and Jeep Meridian in the premium SUV category.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki plans three new models by 2027
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki intends to launch a micro SUV, a three-row SUV, and an electric MPV by 2027. The company is currently testing the Y43 micro SUV on Indian roads. These additions are part of a strategy to increase the brand's presence in the SUV and electric segments.

stories.title: Volkswagen Virtus facelift confirmed for December
stories.summary: Volkswagen will launch a facelift of its Virtus sedan on December 11. The update will focus on minor styling tweaks rather than a full overhaul. The changes are expected to mirror those seen in the Skoda Slavia facelift launched earlier this year.

stories.title: JSW Combat details emerge ahead of launch
stories.summary: JSW Motors will launch the Combat, a plug-in hybrid SUV, on December 3. The vehicle is based on the Jetour T2 and will be assembled locally in India. Spy images confirm the model features specific branding on the front grille to distinguish it from the international version.

stories.title: Triumph Motorcycles launches the Tracker 400 in India at ₹2.46 lakh, - ET Auto
Mahindra and Uber partner on electric three-wheelers
stories.summary: Mahindra and Uber aim to support the adoption of 5,000 electric three-wheelers over the next 12 months. The collaboration uses an EV Auto Advantage programme to improve financing access for drivers. The partnership targets markets where electric vehicle adoption remains low to help drivers switch to electric models.

stories.title: BMW R 12 G/S launched in India
stories.summary: BMW Motorrad has launched the R 12 G/S in India at Rs 25.40 lakh. The motorcycle is available exclusively in the Pro variant and comes standard with Comfort and Enduro packages. It draws inspiration from the 1980 R 80 G/S while featuring modern off-road hardware.

stories.title: Kia reports 6,200 wholesale units for CNG models
stories.summary: Kia has sold 6,200 units of its Carens and Clavis CNG models since their September 2026 launch. The company says the figures reflect customer acceptance of its factory-fitted CNG offerings. Owners are offered an assured residual value of up to 75 per cent after three years.

stories.title: Northampton shopping centre adds rapid chargers
stories.summary: Weston Favell Shopping Centre in Northampton has installed six 75kW rapid electric vehicle charging points. The equipment is maintained and operated by Zest. The centre reports that 20 percent of its 2 million annual vehicle visits are currently made by electric vehicles.

stories.title: Kia Sorento Crosses 4,500 Wholesale Units in India Since Launch - ACKO Drive
CNH breaks ground on Uttar Pradesh tractor plant
stories.summary: CNH Industrial has begun construction on a 100-acre manufacturing facility in Uttar Pradesh. The plant is designed to produce 100,000 tractors annually for domestic and international markets. Operations at the greenfield site are expected to commence by mid-2028.

stories.title: Honda to display Super-N at London motor show
stories.summary: Honda will exhibit its electric Super-N at the London International Motor Show in February 2027. The display will include a 1:17-scale toybox installation that previously toured four UK cities. Visitors will be able to sit inside the vehicle to take photographs.

stories.title: VinFast targets Philippine charging network expansion
stories.summary: After leading Philippine battery-electric vehicle sales in October, VinFast plans to become the country's largest operator of charging stations. CEO Antonio Zara said a wider network would support the company's sales lead. Parent company Vingroup previously announced a $500 million investment for a local manufacturing plant.

stories.title: Ford begins LFP battery production in Michigan
stories.summary: Ford has started producing lithium iron phosphate battery cells at its BlueOval Battery Park Michigan facility. The batteries are intended for prototype versions of the upcoming Fathom electric pickup. The automaker says the move provides greater control over a technology it considers key to affordable electric vehicles.

stories.title: Aptera completes first production solar vehicle
stories.summary: Aptera has finished its first production solar electric vehicle for a customer. The three-wheeled vehicle is finished in a matte black exterior called Noir. After years of development and delays, the company intends to export the vehicle to a customer located outside of the United States.

stories.title: Aptera delivers first solar electric vehicle
stories.summary: Aptera Motors has completed its first solar electric vehicle for sale. The three-wheeled model, designed to harness solar energy for up to 40 miles of daily driving, was built for early investor Martin Hartono. The vehicle is set to be exported outside of the United States.

stories.title: Aptera finishes first customer solar vehicle
stories.summary: Aptera Motors has completed its first solar electric vehicle for a customer. The vehicle, finished in a matte black exterior, was built for early investor Martin Hartono. The company plans to export the unit outside of the United States, marking a milestone for the solar mobility firm.

stories.title: Aptera finishes its first solar electric vehicle for a customer (SEV:NASDAQ) - Seeking Alpha
Aptera builds first solar vehicle for investor
stories.summary: Aptera has finished its first solar electric vehicle for a paying customer. The car is headed to Martin Hartono, an early investor who received priority status. The company has not disclosed the specific handover date, the destination country, or the price paid for the vehicle.

stories.title: Aptera completes first customer solar vehicle
stories.summary: Aptera has finished its first solar electric vehicle for a customer, early investor Martin Hartono. The company plans to export the vehicle outside the United States. Aptera requires approximately $65 million in funding to reach a production target of 500 vehicles per month.

stories.title: Ohio commits $41M to expand electric vehicle charging network statewide - Cleveland.com
Ohio to add 40 fast-charging locations
stories.summary: The Ohio Department of Transportation is installing 40 new electric vehicle charging locations using a federal program. The project is supported by a $31 million federal investment and $10 million in private funding. The state aims to expand reliable charging options for drivers and support economic development.

stories.title: Tata Motors expands commercial vehicle business to Syria
stories.summary: Tata Motors has partnered with Ghassan Aboud Automotive to distribute its commercial vehicles in Syria. The automaker plans to offer cargo vehicles ranging from sub-one-tonne to 60 tonnes, alongside mass mobility solutions with seating capacities of up to 71 passengers. The Middle East remains a key expansion market.

stories.title: Tata Motors partners with Ghassan Aboud Automotive in Syria
stories.summary: Tata Motors has partnered with Ghassan Aboud Automotive and its subsidiary, Grand Auto and Machinery Co., to distribute commercial vehicles in Syria. The agreement covers cargo vehicles from sub-one-tonne to 60 tonnes and passenger transport options. Sales and service support will be provided across the country.

stories.title: Volgren delivers 95 electric buses to Transport for NSW - Automotive World
Renault updates electric van range for 2027
stories.summary: Renault is upgrading its light commercial vehicle range for 2027 with faster charging, increased driving range and expanded connectivity. The electric Kangoo receives a larger battery and more powerful motor, while the openR link multimedia system is being integrated across more models in the lineup.

stories.title: Hyundai to bring Pleos software to Porter trucks
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor plans to equip its next-generation Porter truck with its Pleos software platform for a 2027 launch. The Porter has historically been one of the company's best-selling vehicles in South Korea. The move marks an expansion of Hyundai's software-defined vehicle strategy into the commercial market.

stories.title: South Africa backs emergency plan for Durban port
stories.summary: Transport Minister Barbara Creecy has endorsed emergency measures to address a container backlog at Durban Gateway Terminal. Vessel waiting times have reached 20 days, prompting concerns over the supply of medicines and automotive components. The terminal handles nearly half of the country's containerised freight.

AVES, a Vietnamese Technology Startup, Aims to Launch Its First Electric Vehicles in 2027 - Tech in Asia

stories.title: Owl survives 70-mile journey trapped in truck air dam
stories.summary: A great horned owl survived a collision with a tractor-trailer traveling at 65 mph in Pennsylvania. The bird remained trapped in the vehicle's front air dam for approximately 70 miles before rescuers successfully freed it with few injuries. The owl has since been released.

stories.title: ASK Automotive Q2 FY27 Revenue Rises 47.5% to ₹1,561 Crore - The BRAKE Report
Auto component makers report margin pressure
stories.summary: Indian auto ancillary companies recorded 24.7 percent revenue growth in the first half of fiscal year 2027. Despite the gains, aggregate EBITDA margins contracted 66 basis points to 11.4 percent, driven by tyre-related costs, rising working capital and higher debt levels across the sector.

stories.title: Talbros-Lohum joint venture secures product approvals
stories.summary: The joint venture between Talbros Automotive Components and Lohum has received sample approval from Apollo Tyres and MRF for its recycled carbon black products. The company is currently evaluating a site for an integrated pyrolysis and devulcanisation facility, targeting commercial production by mid-fiscal year 2028.

stories.title: Michelin India expands retail network in Maharashtra
stories.summary: Michelin India has opened a new tyre and service store in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in partnership with Chouhan Tyres. The 11,000 square foot facility provides fitment and maintenance services. This opening brings the company's nationwide retail network to more than 800 points of sale.

stories.title: Apollo Tyres reports profit growth amid rising rubber costs
stories.summary: Apollo Tyres reported a 16.6 percent increase in revenue to 7,968.15 crore rupees for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Net profit rose 13.3 percent to 292.29 crore rupees, though EBITDA fell 15 percent as rubber costs outpaced the company's price increases.

stories.title: Tyre stocks to watch in 2027
stories.summary: Apollo Tyres, Balkrishna Industries and MRF are highlighted as key stocks for 2027 based on recent financial results. Apollo Tyres currently shows the fastest profit growth among the group, while Balkrishna Industries reports the highest return on equity. Each company faces distinct market risks.

stories.title: Oetiker India doubles manufacturing capacity
stories.summary: Oetiker India has inaugurated an expanded manufacturing facility to mark 20 years of operations. The investment is intended to increase production capacity and broaden the company's technology portfolio. The firm aims to leverage the site to support its growth across India and the ASEAN region.

stories.title: Lumafield study reveals quality risk in the automotive connector supply chain
stories.summary: Lumafield compared 1,500 automotive electrical connectors, finding that open-market parts often differ from genuine units in material and internal structure. While identical on the outside, these variations could cause electrical failures if substituted into the supply chain. A typical car relies on over 1,000 such contacts.

stories.title: Cooper Standard wins automotive innovation award
stories.summary: Cooper Standard received a 2026 Society of Plastics Engineers Automotive Innovation Award for its FlexiCore thermoplastic body sealing technology. The technology was featured on the Volvo Cars EX60 and is expanding across global vehicle programs. The company says it is proud to receive the recognition.

stories.title: Hertz is shutting down its used-car stores
stories.summary: Hertz is closing its dedicated Hertz Car Sales locations to focus on its nationwide rental network. The company says it is leveraging its existing channels to advance its strategy. The rental counter is now the showroom. Forty-five lots are reportedly set to close by November 20.

stories.title: Five Star Automotive buys 6 stores in Indianapolis area as Dreyer & Reinbold exits auto retail - Automotive News
Lithia enters South Carolina with purchase of 3 Hyundai, Genesis dealerships in Charleston - Automotive News
HPL Motors opens sixth used car dealership in Barnsley
stories.summary: HPL Motors has opened its sixth used car dealership in Barnsley, its third showroom launch in two years. The expansion follows a majority stake acquisition by Marubeni Auto Investment UK in 2023. The group says the backing has enabled it to accelerate investment and strengthen vehicle supply capabilities.

stories.title: Taming the cash-flow killer: Overcoming dead stock in auto dealerships
stories.summary: Automotive dealers are encouraged to maintain a 30-day average inventory turnover to keep working capital circulating and interest costs manageable. Inventory is described as a double-edged sword, as maintaining stock is necessary for demand but represents frozen capital when vehicles or parts sit on the lot.

stories.title: The empty chair: Why automotive retail needs to put customers before leads
stories.summary: Research by iovox indicates that 86% of unsuccessful calls to dealerships occurred during normal opening hours. The report suggests that retailers often prioritize lead generation and conversion rates over the customer perspective. The customer is described as the empty chair in many conversations about automotive retail.

stories.title: Codeweavers adds digital ID checks before finance submissions
stories.summary: Codeweavers has launched VerifyID, a tool integrated into its Point of Sale platform that allows customers to verify their identity using their own devices. The company says the tool replaces manual document inspections and takes minutes to complete. It aims to reduce application delays and strengthen finance evidence.

stories.title: Xpeng targets 100 UK dealers by end of 2027
stories.summary: Xpeng aims to grow its UK network to 100 locations by the end of 2027 to become the market’s top premium electric vehicle brand. The manufacturer currently has 22 sales locations and two service sites. It wants a dealership within 30 minutes of its customers.

stories.title: AutoRaptor releases used car sales data
stories.summary: AutoRaptor released rankings of best-selling used vehicles based on 136,449 retail sales at independent dealerships since January 2024. The data shows the Ford F-150 is a consistent seller, though preferences shift by state. The company says this reflects what independent dealers actually sold off their lots.

stories.title: SC: Assess buyer's liability before home loan recovery
stories.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that commercial courts cannot force flat buyers to repay financiers in incomplete housing projects without first examining the nexus between banks and insolvent builders. The order provides relief to homebuyers in projects where banks released funds to rogue developers. The nexus is unholy.

stories.title: Bank of Baroda launches EV infrastructure financing scheme with loans up to ₹5 crore - ET Auto
Bank of Baroda launches bob Green PLUG scheme
stories.summary: Bank of Baroda has launched bob Green PLUG, a financing scheme for EV charging stations and battery-swapping infrastructure. The bank offers financing from 10 lakh to 5 crore rupees. The scheme is designed to support the bank's commitment to sustainable finance and India's growing EV charging ecosystem.

stories.title: Yes Bank bondholders question RBI appeal
stories.summary: The Yes Bank AT1 Bond Holders Association has asked the Reserve Bank of India to explain why it is challenging a Supreme Court ruling that restored ₹8,415 crore in written-off bonds. The association wants to know the public interest behind the regulator's move to contest investor relief.

stories.title: EPFO sees no legal way to recover 1,816 crore from Reliance Capital
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation has concluded there is no legal route to recover over 1,800 crore rupees of retirement savings invested in Reliance Capital. The retirement body informed its board that it cannot pursue further recovery. The development raises questions about the fund's investment risk management.

stories.title: IIFL Finance expects short-term stress in gold loans
stories.summary: IIFL Finance anticipates short-term stress in its gold loan portfolio if prices remain weak. The company noted that while gold prices are at recent lows, historic credit loss data across price cycles has not exceeded 0.7 percent. Customers are currently being given time to rebalance their positions.

stories.title: India Studies Tax Proposals to Encourage Stock Trading, Curb Speculative Bets - Bloomberg.com
Retail lending grows as defaults rise
stories.summary: India's retail lending book grew 18.8 percent to ₹185.2 lakh crore in the second quarter, according to CRIF. Consumer durables, personal loans, and two-wheeler loans now account for nearly half of new-to-credit accounts. Rising defaults in these segments suggest that borrowing is becoming easier than paying back.

stories.title: KKR invests in Gentari renewables platform
stories.summary: KKR has made a minority investment in Gentari Renewables India to support the platform's expansion. Gentari cites supportive market fundamentals and increasing renewable energy demand as key drivers for the move. The company continues to view India as a primary market for its clean energy solutions.

stories.title: Software-defined vehicle market projected to hit $310 billion
stories.summary: Market Growth Reports projects the global software-defined vehicle market will reach $310.46 billion by 2035, growing at a 20.74 percent CAGR. Manufacturers are shifting from hardware-focused development to software-controlled platforms, creating new opportunities for tech providers. The industry is currently undergoing a significant transformation.

stories.title: Aptiv launches PRISM AI platform for next-generation ADAS - Automotive World
Geotab adds driver fatigue detection
stories.summary: Geotab has introduced AI-powered features for its dashcams, including fatigue monitoring and two-way audio. The tools are designed to help fleet managers identify safety risks and monitor driving behavior in real time. The platform now includes automated privacy settings that adjust based on the vehicle's location.

stories.title: AEye embeds AI across engineering to cut lidar costs - Automotive World
Qualcomm takes on Wayve, Chinese rivals with new AI driving platform - Automotive News
Rivian sets 9 December date for second Autonomy & AI Day - Automotive World
CES 2027 mobility agenda focuses on software
stories.summary: The Consumer Technology Association is highlighting software-defined mobility at CES 2027, with exhibits covering air, land, and sea. The event features 350,000 square feet of vehicle tech and keynotes from Waymo and Stellantis. The industry is now framing various modes of transport as one connected system.

stories.title: Foxconn Acquires Sony Semiconductor Solutions’ Automotive Camera Module Business - Photonics Spectra
Climate Cymru defends 2030 electric vehicle target
stories.summary: A network of 430 organisations is urging the Welsh Government to maintain the UK target for 80 percent of new cars to be zero-emission by 2030. Campaigners argue that reducing the target would leave households exposed to volatile oil prices for longer. The mandate sets rising annual sales requirements.

stories.title: Minister declines to regulate EV charging prices
stories.summary: Energy minister Darragh O’Brien has ruled out regulating public electric vehicle charging prices. This follows a government report warning that the narrowing cost gap between EVs and combustion engines may undermine public confidence. The ESB recently increased prices for its public chargers for the second time this year.

stories.title: Government defends ethanol-blended petrol program
stories.summary: The Centre has issued a clarification regarding its Ethanol Blended Petrol Programme, citing scientific validation and field trials to rebut claims about E20 fuel. The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas stated the rollout was carefully calibrated following years of testing. It maintains there is no evidence of harm.

stories.title: Public Accounts Committee to review EV grant overpayments
stories.summary: The Committee of Public Accounts is set to examine up to €3.9 million in overpayments of electric vehicle grants by the Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland. The watchdog will review the agency's 2025 financial statements. The grant scheme was intended to help Ireland meet its transport emission targets.

stories.title: Irvine car dealer renews licence despite dispute
stories.summary: A North Ayrshire licensing board has allowed a second-hand car dealer to renew his licence following a dispute with a customer over an 11-year-old Nissan Qashqai. The dealer noted that in 36 years of trading, he had never previously faced an objection to his licence renewal.

stories.title: Ayrshire dealer licence renewed after customer objection
stories.summary: An Irvine car dealer successfully renewed his licence despite a formal objection from a customer regarding a vehicle purchase. The dealer told the licensing board that he had maintained a clean record for 36 years. The board approved the renewal following a hearing last Wednesday.

stories.title: Bail refused for woman accused of targeting dealership
stories.summary: A 31-year-old woman has been refused bail after being accused of involvement in an attempted theft of tools from vehicles at a dealership in Northern Ireland. Prosecutors alleged the woman and an accomplice were seen rummaging through cars before being confronted by members of the public.

stories.title: Used car dealer ordered to repay £10
stories.summary: A used car dealer who pocketed over £40,000 through consumer protection offences has been ordered to repay £10 or face a day in jail. John Minnis and Anthony Miller misled customers by taking deposits for cars they never delivered. The court order is now in effect.

stories.title: Subaru unveils limited WRX tS GD25 and BRZ tS ZC15 - Automotive World
Audi launches vehicle recycling subsidiary
stories.summary: Audi is establishing Audi Circular Solutions GmbH to create a business model around vehicle dismantling and recycled material recovery. Starting in 2027, the subsidiary will manage the end of a vehicle's life cycle by selling used parts and securing raw materials. The circular economy is now a business.

stories.title: Saarthi GreenTech proposes hydrogen engine retrofits
stories.summary: Saarthi GreenTech is exploring hydrogen retrofitting as a way to clean up existing diesel engines rather than replacing them. CEO Alok Kumar argues that replacing entire fleets with new electric or fuel-cell vehicles is too costly. The company is looking for ways to make current engines cleaner today.

stories.title: India reports 46-fold growth in EV sales
stories.summary: India's annual electric vehicle sales reached 2.3 million units in 2025, up from 50,000 in 2016. The government cites policy support and technological innovation as key drivers for this transition. The country is now positioning electric mobility as a pillar of its vision for a self-reliant future.

stories.title: Spain reports record electric vehicle registrations
stories.summary: Spain is seeing a surge in electric vehicle adoption, with September marking a record for registrations. The country is leveraging government incentives and a growing charging network to meet European decarbonization goals. Affordable models priced below 25,000 euros are helping the automotive sector reach this new milestone.

stories.title: IEA links oil shock to energy transition
stories.summary: The International Energy Agency reports that the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz is accelerating the global shift to electric vehicles and solar energy. The report concludes that the largest oil shock in history is creating powerful incentives for countries to abandon oil and develop domestic energy generation.

stories.title: India's biogas potential remains largely untapped
stories.summary: A report from the Confederation of Indian Industry and EY-Parthenon suggests India could replace its 2030 LNG imports with compressed biogas. However, only one in four registered plants is currently operational. The country has enough waste to theoretically cover 80 percent of its projected gas needs.

stories.title: Lloyd's Register introduces EV fire safety notation
stories.summary: Lloyd's Register has launched a new notation to address fire risks associated with electric vehicles on car carriers. The move follows industry efforts to improve safety standards for transporting battery-powered vehicles. The notation provides a framework for managing fire hazards in maritime logistics.

stories.title: Tensile testing for electric vehicle components
stories.summary: Electric vehicle manufacturers are using tensile testing to verify the strength and reliability of battery components and wire harnesses. These procedures must meet ISO and ASTM standards to ensure quality control. Like gas-powered vehicles, EVs must undergo a series of force tests before reaching the dealership.

stories.title: CATL CEO challenges Europe’s push for local battery recycling - Automotive News
Kia plans affordable electric model for 2027
stories.summary: Kia intends to launch a new electric vehicle in 2027 with a starting price between 20,000 and 22,000 euros. The automaker is developing a dedicated platform for entry-level models alongside Hyundai. The move aims to increase the brand's presence in the affordable electric segment.

stories.title: Electric Land Rover Defender confirmed for 2027
stories.summary: Jaguar Land Rover will launch a smaller electric Defender in 2027, with production starting next year at its Halewood factory. CEO PB Balaji confirmed the model will share a production line with the upcoming Range Rover GT electric SUV. The Defender brand is expanding its lineup.

stories.title: Kia EV3 and K4 named award finalists
stories.summary: The Kia EV3 and K4 Hatchback have been named finalists for the 2027 North American Car, Truck and Utility Vehicle of the Year awards. This marks the first time Kia has secured finalist spots in both categories during the same year. Jurors evaluated the vehicles on performance and versatility.

stories.title: Nissan uses Mexico to prepare for Chinese competition
stories.summary: Nissan is using its Mexican operations as a testing ground to reduce manufacturing costs and prepare for competition from Chinese automakers in the United States. Chairman Christian Meunier says the company has a two-year window to streamline engineering and automation before Chinese rivals establish local assembly plants.

research.title: Radar-Native Control Barrier Functions: Doppler Range Rate as a Measured Barrier Derivative
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Safe control around dynamic obstacles requires information about both distance and relative motion. Range-based filters commonly reconstruct the required range rate from successive range measurements or from obstacle-state estimators, which can introduce estimator delay or sensitivity. research.title: Recoverability, Not Invariance: Certified Safety for Robots at the Limits of Performance
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Safety certification in robotics typically rests on forward invariance of the deployed controller, a property that demands high-fidelity models at the edge of the operating envelope, exactly where models are least reliable and robots perform best. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Scalable Vehicle Charging Coordination for Online Operations: A Column Generation Approach
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider an electric vehicle charging scheduling problem for long-haul freight transport. To mitigate unforeseen waiting times caused by congestion and limited charger capacity, we consider a coordinated scheduling approach that prioritizes scalable, computationally efficient scheduling. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
